gate.kill_switch_1_learned_lifts_ceiling: if learned-3072 does not beat random-3072 overall by >= +0.01 at matched atoms and MACs, the random basis is not the binding constraint and the learned-dictionary thesis fails at this budget

sparse.learned_dictionary: mini-batch k-means (VQ) centroids fitted on a registered 2,000,000-whitened-patch pool (3,000 train images, seed 22); 60 iterations, batch 131072, moving-average lr = 1/(1+it), dead-centroid reinit from the pool; same 108-dim whitened space as random atoms
sparse.random_dictionary: M108 arm (a) exact: prefix of the seeded permutation of the shared 8192-whitened-patch pool
sparse.topk_codes: keep the top-64 nearest-atom triangle activations per patch, zero the rest, pool; the code is zero-padded to the full atom dimension so per-image MACs are the SAME as arm (b) (sparse code, dense storage).
